preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (0xBd51b6D98574327734C1621A7283778c5e6Af86e)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable the swap and liquify mechanism, effectively stopping automated liquidity additions and potentially freezing token transfers that rely on this functionality. This demonstrates the owner's ability to unilaterally disrupt normal contract operations.
